voice.name: en-US-AndrewNeural
voice.prosody: The best time is opening time or just before closing. Allow at least three hours, and bring water. Entry is paid, and the Turkish museum pass is valid. The Terrace Houses need a separate ticket. Local tip: on the way back, drive up to the hill village of Şirince. In the evening, eat small lamb skewers in Selçuk. Your next stop is the Temple of Artemis, about four kilometres by car, around ten minutes.
